answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, while correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs penalties proportional to O(k^2), preventing a sybil operator from multiplying influence cheaply. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, and asymmetric depreciation reduces recoverable stake and future weight. Thus zenith gains remain unreachable: each pearl of coordination exposes the ledge of collective liability.
